title: PRIVATE TOUR SEOUL BASIC
route: Nami Island - Gyeongbok Palace - Namdaemun Market - Itaewon Mosque

includes: Professional Licensed Driving Guide (English Speaking) (D1, D2) (10 Hours Basis)
K-ETA Application - Complimentary For Malaysian (1 time)
excludes: Private Driver & Guide is based on 8 hours basis. 30,000 - 60,000 KRW will be charged for every extra hour usage.

itinerary.title: Nami Island
activities: Strawberry Farm (fruit picking experience: Dec - Feb only) OR Starfield Library @ COEX Mall (Mar - Nov only)
Nami Island (filming location for Winter Sonata)

itinerary.title: Seoul City
activities: Namdaemun Market (shopping for souvenirs and brooches)
Gyeongbok Palace (the main royal historical palace in Seoul)
Itaewon Mosque (the first mosque in South Korea)

expect.title: Lunch & Dinner Excluded
expect.body: No lunch and dinner, and no breakfast if you choose the apartment. The guide will bring you to a halal-friendly restaurant or convenience store.

expect.title: Airport Transfer
expect.body: Please bring a maximum of 1 luggage per pax, as it affects car capacity.

expect.title: Driving Guide
expect.body: Korean English-speaking driving guide. Free & Easy days are at your own expense.

expect.title: Driving Guide & Transport
expect.body: 10 hours basis. 30,000 - 60,000 KRW will be charged for each extra hour.

expect.title: Accommodation
expect.body: Rooms are small, typically 15-20 sqf (Korean standard). Triple rooms offer even less space.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will be charged if the booking is made less than 45 days before departure.
This package is valid until the 31st December 2026 travel period.
Private transportation & driving guide is based on 10 hours basis. 30,000 - 60,000 KRW will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be made in cash.
A driving guide will be provided for groups of 2 to 9 pax.
A private driver and a professional tour guide will be provided for groups of 10 pax and above.
Itinerary, price and flight are subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary 14 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting domestic flights.

deposit.text: prior to arrival for full payment
